metaTitle: Custom Full Color Embroidered Patches | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom full color embroidered patches for your brand. Perfect for uniforms, events, and giveaways. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Full color embroidered patches let you reproduce logos, mascots, or detailed artwork with multiple thread colors and fine stitchwork. Unlike standard one- or two-color patches, full color embroidery captures gradients, shading, and small text with precision. These patches work well for team uniforms, corporate jackets, and event merchandise where brand recognition matters. Choose a twill or felt base, and add a heat-seal or sew-on backing for easy application. Bulk orders keep per-unit costs low for large campaigns.
heroAltText: Custom full color embroidered patches with detailed threadwork and a heat-seal backing
